summary: Temporary drone danger area at Bradwell Common, Milton Keynes, with drone flights limited to 400 feet above ground, daily from 0800 to 0400.
text:
TEMPO DANGER AREA (TDA) EGD287A INSTALLED WI 1.61NM RADIUS OF
520232N 0004556W (BRADWELL COMMON, MILTON KEYNES). BEYOND VISUAL 
LINE OF SIGHT UAS OPS CONTAINED WHOLLY WI THE TDA. MAX HGT 400FT 
AGL. EMERG SERVICES ACFT MAY ENTER THE AIRSPACE IN ACCORDANCE WITH 
LOCAL DECONFLICTION AGREEMENTS. OPEN AND SPECIFIC CAT VISUAL LINE OF 
SIGHT UAS OPS ARE PERMITTED WI THE TDA WITHOUT PRIOR APPROVAL OR 
DECONFLICTION. OTHER NON-STANDARD FLIGHT, FLIGHT RESTRICTION ZONE OR 
CONTROLLED AIRSPACE APPROVALS MUST BE OBTAINED. OPERATORS ARE 
REMINDED OF THEIR RESPONSIBILITY UNDER CAP722 5.2.2.3 REGARDING OPR 
IN CLOSE PROXIMITY TO AN EMERG RESPONSE EFFORT. 
FOR INFO AROPS(AT)CAA.CO.UK. 
DEC 24-JAN 03 CTC DFR(AT)HAMPSHIRE.POLICE.UK. 
AR-2026-6559/04.
